messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: canary-id=canary-2026-03-15-42 in us-west-2. Initial healthchecks passing.
incident-bot: ALERT: canary-2026-03-15-42 healthcheck failures detected (svc/rt-infer). 5xx spike > alert threshold (5.0%). Paging Alex (oncall).
Alex (oncall): I'm looking. Opening logs and metrics now. Can someone paste the canary config? :eyes:
Samir (runtime): config is the usual fanout-2, kvcache enabled. Rolling out new kv-cache eviction change in this canary.
Maria (eng-sre): Seeing increased 502/504 from the instance group behind lb-usw2-infer-2. Error pattern looks like "out_of_memory" in process logs. Attaching last 5 lines:
```
[14:01:12] model-server: alloc failed: 134217728 bytes
[14:01:12] model-server: OOM when allocating KV cache shard
[14:01:12] model-server: returning 502 to client
[14:01:13] nginx: upstream 10.0.10.42 timed out (110: Connection timed out)
[14:01:13] healthcheck: FAIL
```
Alex (oncall): OOM on new eviction path. That could explain 5xx spike. Impact window starting ~14:00Z.
Joe (support): Support queue is seeing a handful of customer errors: ~12 queries failing across 3 tenants, most are short-lived but some retries piling up. I opened a case for the top customer; I'll update.
Samir (runtime): Recommend toggling the new eviction flag off and aborting the canary. We have a runtime flag: `runtime.kvcache.eviction_v2 = true`.
Alex (oncall): Agreed. Initiating kill-switch for the canary and redirecting traffic to baseline. Maria, can you help with verification after flag flip?
Maria (eng-sre): Ready. Alex, flip it and then we'll re-run healthchecks.
Alex (oncall): Executing:
```
# flip flag on canary hosts
redwood runtime-flag set --canary canary-2026-03-15-42 runtime.kvcache.eviction_v2 false
# trigger canary healthcheck probe
redwood canary probe --canary canary-2026-03-15-42 --wait 60s
```
Samir (runtime): :thumbsup: Also throttling fanout to 1 while we stabilize: `redwood fanout set --canary canary-... --fanout 1`.
incident-bot: COMMAND: rollback initiated by Alex (oncall) for canary-2026-03-15-42. Rollback plan: stop canary instances -> drain -> remove from LB -> mark rollback complete. ETA ~4m.
Alex (oncall): Rolling back now.
Maria (eng-sre): Healthchecks re-running... host 10.0.10.42 transitioned to OK after eviction flag flip. 5xx rate falling back to baseline.
Joe (support): Notified affected customers with brief note: "We observed elevated errors during a canary rollout and have stopped the canary; service restored to normal. We're following up with root cause + timeline." Customers acknowledged, no escalations so far.
Samir (runtime): Post-rollback, let's add a temporary guard to block future canaries with eviction_v2 until we widen the testbed. I'll create a canary gate that requires explicit opt-in.
Alex (oncall): Agreed. For immediate mitigation: canary aborted, rollback complete. Can we confirm user-facing error rate returned to normal?
Maria (eng-sre): Confirmed: aggregate 5xx rate across production in us-west-2 returned to baseline within 90s of rollback. No ongoing customer impact.
Joe (support): Closing the active tickets but leaving a follow-up to notify customers with a detailed RCA later.
Samir (runtime): I'll open a postmortem PR with the experiment config that caused the OOM and steps to reproduce on staging.
Alex (oncall): Handing off to Maria for the long-form RCA and follow-up. I'm out for the next 30m; Maria, take it from here and coordinate with runtime team + support.
Maria (eng-sre): Taking over. I'll draft the initial incident note and tag runtime + prod-eng. Planning offline follow-up: - reproduce, - add guard, - increase OOM visibility in canary probes.
incident-bot: Handoff: Alex -> Maria at 14:28Z. Incident closed for on-call page. Please update the incident channel with RCA when ready.
Joe (support): Thanks both. I'll add the customer case IDs to the incident note.
Samir (runtime): Quick note for the RCA: consider per-model kvcache caps to avoid global OOM under slightly mis-sized shards.
Alex (oncall): Nice. :raised_hands: Good job team.

[thread summary]
- Issue: canary canary-2026-03-15-42 triggered OOMs causing elevated 5xx and failed healthchecks in us-west-2
- Action: kill-switch (runtime flag flip) + abort/rollback of canary, fanout throttled
- Impact: ~12 failing requests across 3 tenants, transient; no long-term degradation
- Next steps: block canary opt-in for eviction_v2, reproduce in staging, RCA authored by Maria + Samir
